nui 1
const Unit: number = 95
const Delta: number = 12
const Ticks: number[] = [1]
for Tick in @Ticks carry Values: number[] = [95, 107] carry Total: number = 12 {
point Incoming = coordinate(x: @Values[0], y: @Total)
const Mapped: number[] = for Item in @Values { if (@Tick > 0) { @Item + @Tick } else { 1 / 0 } }
const InnerTicks: number[] = [12]
for InnerTick in @InnerTicks carry Inner: number = @Total {
next Inner = @Inner + @Values[0] + @InnerTick
}
next Total = @Inner
next Values = @Mapped
}
const Final0: number = @Values[0]
const Final1: number = @Values[1]
const FinalTotal: number = @Total
point Final = coordinate(x: @Final0, y: @FinalTotal)
